contact_loss: set requested force to zero; reset integral; exclude from tracking window and fail if >=2 losses
metric: mean absolute post-step force error over last five retained-contact steps
pass: strict ordered target realized force and each feedback MAE <=0.8 * no-feedback MAE at its target
causal_rule: command at action k uses only post-step force k-1; first command is zero
stop: if tracking fails do not launch online task outcomes
